title: Other parties, dances and requests to the band
summary: Organizations gave dances with bands; musicians played what they wanted with some requests, and feeding the kitty bought a request. Reel two begins.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I remember. That was a great party. And there were other parties and dances and things that any number of people gave in New Orleans, organizations and the like that had bands, and they were fun. Music was often good. Musicians played pretty much what they wanted with some request. Yeah.
At the dance halls when they fed the kitty, it would usually be for their request, if I remember that. Yeah.
Basically speaking, if you wanted the band to play something, somebody would go up and say, do you... .
We've got reel two on there, August the 1st, 1978. Bernie, you were talking about going in with a band?
